profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud security company (Nasdaq: ZS) that describes itself as a leading provider of zero-trust security for enterprise customers undergoing digital transformation. The company's core platform, the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange, is designed to connect users, devices, and applications through a cloud-native framework rather than traditional network perimeter defenses. Its site emphasizes partnerships and integrations as part of its deployment model, and it positions itself as operating what it calls the largest security cloud on the planet.

Zscaler's tracked AI product, listed as Zscaler AI, encompasses its cloud security AI capabilities within a security service edge platform, including data loss prevention and AI traffic inspection. The company notes on its site that a unified zero-trust framework for tracing data lineage and governing agent-to-agent interactions is central to maintaining compliance and competitive advantage, reflecting an orientation toward AI workload security alongside traditional enterprise use cases.

Zscaler is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001713683 and trades under the ticker ZS. No litigation or MCP server presence is recorded in the held facts.
